pr_body:
Objects and fields with `[synthetic_source_keep:arrays]`, when nested under object arrays with [synthetic_source_keep:none], are the only use cases requiring the second parsing pass for docs with synthetic source. It's simpler to just record singleton values for them in ignored source, avoiding the extra complexity and performance hit for the second pass.

One downside is that there's additional overhead when the array contains only singleton instances of these objects and fields - using ignored source is not needed here. Still, this should be a corner case (parent object not tracking source, sub-fields tracking array source, appearing as singletons only), so this looks like a good tradeoff.

Fixes #115261
pr_title: Track source for objects and fields with [synthetic_source_keep:arrays] in arrays as ignored
pr_comment:
> This looks like a good simplification that should also improve performance. Did you have a chance to run this with the elastic/logs track and see what how this improves indexing throughput?

I don't think this will show up in benchmarks, as we've enabled storing array source in logsdb.. The second pass only kicks in if the parent array is not stored.

Shard of indices using setting would not be able allocate if this setting is used, but it has been removed. That what branches did this setting get back ported? I think just removing the setting, should fix the issue, but would be good to double check this.
This was added to 8.16, not used anywhere as it's a last-resort setting: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/114649
